closest_parent_domain.justification: Among the identified parent domains, "algorithm engineering" is the closest parent domain for "hardware implementation of algorithms" as it deals with the design, analysis, and practical implementation aspects of algorithms specifically, which is directly related to optimizing and executing algorithms on hardware.

child_domains.justification: Hardware acceleration is a specialized use-case of hardware implementation of algorithms, as it refers to running algorithms efficiently using dedicated hardware.

closest_child_domain.justification: "Hardware acceleration" is the closest child domain because it is a direct application and optimization of the broader domain of implementing algorithms effectively in hardware.
